description: Per-root CSS cascade ratchet baselines (SYS-CSS-CASCADE-GOVERNANCE). layeredFloorPct is a ratchet: a change may raise it (improvement) but must never land below it; lowering a floor is a deliberate reviewed edit of this file with a dated note. The !important ceilings stay governed in scripts/css-layer-validator.js PROJECT_LAYER_ROOTS and must equal importantCeiling here. The 80% layered target remains the long-term goal, enforced as information until floors reach it.

css/site.css.note: 2026-11-19 baseline: 18.0% layered, 200/200 !important (ceiling fully consumed — any new !important must remove an old one)

css/home.css.note: 2026-11-19 baseline: 35.3% layered, 52 !important (no ceiling yet — unlayered pilot root)
